components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-gold); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-gold); color: var(--color-ink); font: 600 12px/1.25 var(--font-inter), sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d7b979; border-color: #b99354; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.99); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 45%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting route or lower-priority shopping action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 18%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-ivory); color: var(--color-ink); font: 600 12px/1.25 var(--font-inter), sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-stone) 55%, transparent); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 35%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-deep-teal) 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Service Button
components.description: A strong fit, guidance, or service action.
components.css: .ds-btn-teal { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-deep-teal); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-deep-teal); color: white; font: 600 12px/1.25 var(--font-inter), sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-teal:hover { background: #136868; border-color: #136868; } .ds-btn-teal:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-deep-teal) 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Commerce Button
components.description: The tall transactional action used for add-to-bag and checkout.
components.css: .ds-btn-commerce { min-height: 56px; padding: 14px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-ivory); font: 600 12px/1.25 var(--font-inter), sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-commerce:hover { background: var(--color-deep-teal); border-color: var(--color-deep-teal); } .ds-btn-commerce:active { transform: scale(.99); } .ds-btn-commerce:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-deep-teal) 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Product Search
components.description: A compact catalog search field with explicit retail language.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; height: 44px; align-items: center; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 12%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-ivory); padding: 0 12px; color: var(--color-smoke); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-deep-teal); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-deep-teal) 15%, transparent); } .ds-search svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-inter), sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--color-smoke); } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); }

components.description: The canonical product image, vendor, title, and price presentation.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-product-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 10%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-ivory); color: var(--color-ink); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(11,15,20,.03); transition: border-color 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; } .ds-product-card:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 25%, transparent); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-product-image { display: grid; aspect-ratio: 4/5; place-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 8%, transparent); background: var(--color-product-canvas); color: var(--color-smoke); font: 600 10px/1.25 var(--font-inter), sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; } .ds-product-copy { padding: 16px; } .ds-product-vendor { margin: 0; color: var(--color-smoke); font: 600 10px/1.25 var(--font-inter), sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-product-card h3 { margin: 6px 0 0; font: 600 16px/1.5 var(--font-inter), sans-serif; } .ds-product-price { margin: 12px 0 0; font: 700 17px/1.3 var(--font-inter), sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-product-card:focus-within { outline: 4px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-deep-teal) 35%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Retail Badge

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: A restrained storefront navigation row with a clear active state.
components.html: ShopSuitsShirtsBrands
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; gap: 28px; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 8%, transparent); background: var(--color-ivory); padding: 0 24px; } .ds-nav a { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 75%, transparent); font: 500 14px/1.5 var(--font-inter), sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { color: var(--color-deep-teal); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-deep-teal) 35%, transparent); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-active { color: var(--color-deep-teal); font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
The interface should feel like entering a well-run independent menswear store: composed at the threshold, merchandise-forward once browsing begins, and personally helpful when fit or occasion creates uncertainty. Editorial type and campaign imagery establish authority; clear product grids, prices, filters, and shopping actions make the experience commercially direct.

Luxury comes from proportion, restraint, product presentation, and knowledgeable service—not from hiding utility or adding ornamental friction. The system is bright and breathable, with dark ink anchoring navigation and trust moments, brass-gold reserved for decisive commercial emphasis, and deep teal carrying fit guidance and service actions.
keyCharacteristics: Merchandise-first layouts with a clear route from discovery to product.
Editorial serif headlines paired with compact, highly legible commerce typography.
Restrained gold emphasis and trustworthy deep-teal service cues.
Bright product surfaces, quiet borders, and low ambient elevation.
Direct shopping controls supported by human fit expertise.

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold signals decisive commercial emphasis; teal signals guidance and service. Do not use both to compete for the same action.

rules.name: The Product-First Canvas Rule
rules.body: Product imagery sits on the dedicated warm Product Canvas unless campaign art explicitly calls for a dark editorial treatment.

rules.name: The Serif Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Use the display face for editorial hierarchy, not for prices, filters, form labels, availability, or cart mechanics.

rules.name: The Price Must Scan Rule
rules.body: Prices use the sans-serif face with stronger weight and tighter tracking than surrounding metadata.

rules.name: The Browse Before Brand Story Rule
rules.body: On commerce entry surfaces, category and product discovery appear before extended showroom, history, or service storytelling.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Product cards stay visually quiet at rest and gain emphasis through border, image, or slight position changes on interaction.

rules.name: The Radius by Role Rule
rules.body: Controls use medium corners, cards use large corners, and pills communicate metadata or selectable facets.

dos: Do put merchandise, categories, prices, filters, and purchase paths ahead of extended brand storytelling on shop surfaces.
Do use real product and campaign imagery with stable aspect ratios and useful alternative text.
Do preserve visible focus, 2.75rem minimum targets, and clear hover, loading, disabled, success, and error states.
Do use gold sparingly for primary commercial emphasis and teal for fit or service guidance.
Do keep Shopify data and repository content as the source of truth for prices, availability, brands, ratings, and claims.
donts: Don't turn the site into a generic marketplace or a discount-first visual system.
Don't hide shopping utilities behind decorative luxury conventions.
Don't use Playfair Display for dense transactional text, controls, prices, or form mechanics.
Don't introduce new claims, badges, scarcity messages, testimonials, or promotional prices without real data.
Don't add new corner, shadow, or accent treatments when an existing component role already fits.
